project.objective: Identify the husband of Unna Halsteinsdatter, born May 1745 in Hestdal, Meland, Hordaland, Norway, and the date of the marriage

questions.question: Whom did Unna Halsteinsdatter (b. May 1745, Hestdal, Meland, Hordaland, Norway) marry, and when?
questions.rationale: Primary research objective. No records have been searched yet.

quirks: Norwegian name spellings were set by the recorder and vary between records (the wiki's example: the given name Sivert written as Syver, Sjur, Siver, Sifuer or Siffuer) — search given-name spelling variants, not just the tree's spelling, before concluding a nil. (FamilySearch Wiki: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Norway_Church_Records)
Before about 1850 most Norwegians used patronymics: Halsteinsdatter means daughter of Halstein. (FamilySearch Wiki: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Norway_Naming_Customs)

Meland, including the farm Hestdal, was a sokn (annex parish) of Hamre prestegjeld; its baptisms, marriages and burials are in the Hamre kirkebøker, 1677-1928. (FamilySearch Wiki: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Meland_Parish,_Hordaland,_Norway_Genealogy)
